product_overview: The E-Budgeting System is a web-based application for managing corporate budget requests and monitoring budget usage across the organization. It supports user login, budget submission workflows, tracking, and administrative management for superadmin users.
core_goals: Log in to access role-appropriate budgeting and administration features
Create budget submissions through the PPBJ, Proposal Harga, and Internal Agreement workflow
View budget and submission status information from a dashboard
Track the progress and history of submitted budget requests
Manage users and departments from the superadmin area

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows users to sign in and reach the application areas available to their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See login error message

features.name: Dashboard Statistics
features.description: Shows an overview of budget and activity metrics for authenticated users.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View total users, budget plans versus used amounts, and active proposals

features.name: Budget Submission Flow
features.description: Lets authenticated users create and submit budget requests through the PPBJ, Proposal Harga, and Internal Agreement steps.
user_flows: Navigate to /pengajuan -> Create PPBJ request -> Add Proposal Harga -> Create Internal Agreement -> Submit budget request
Navigate to /pengajuan -> Create PPBJ request -> Add Proposal Harga -> Create Internal Agreement -> Submit budget request -> See submission recorded in the budget workflow

features.name: Submission Tracking
features.description: Lets users monitor the current status and history of submitted budget requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /tracking -> View active submission statuses and tracking timeline

features.name: Superadmin Dashboard
features.description: Provides superadmin users with an administrative overview of the system.
user_flows: Navigate to /superadmin -> View system administration overview

features.name: User Management
features.description: Allows superadmin users to manage employee accounts and access roles.
user_flows: Navigate to /superadmin/users -> View existing users and assigned roles

features.name: Department Management
features.description: Allows superadmin users to configure organizational departments.
user_flows: Navigate to /superadmin/departments -> View existing departments and organizational settings

features.name: Dashboard Statistics
features.description: Overview of budget and user counts

features.name: Budget Submission Flow
features.description: Multi-step process to submit budget requests
